meta.triageRationale: A defect with one established remedy: the daemon install paths already ask for C++17 through CXXFLAGS, and the remaining bare installs need the same setting. It touches two workflow files and the build instructions, with no code or contract change.

body.focus: Every supported way of installing the repository must ask for the same C++ standard the daemon install paths already use, so fs-ext compiles in CI and when a developer follows the build instructions. The daemon install paths keep their existing behaviour. The fix must confirm on macOS that a clean install with the documented command succeeds.
body.summary: The root install steps in ci.yml and vscode-plugin.yml now set CXXFLAGS=-std=c++17, and CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/installation.md and docs/daemon.md give the install command with that flag. A clean install of origin/v2 on macOS with the flag exited 0 and fs-ext loaded; the output is in docs/standalone/give-every-repository-install-c-standard-E202611096f1f61f2/S001/evidence/macos-clean-install.txt. The workflows were not run on GitHub, and a bare install without the flag still fails on macOS, as agreed with the user.
